| notes = 
When [[Square Enix]] has decided that a [[server]] is over-populated, a [[World Shifter]] will appear, for a period of time, and offer to register characters for migration to a less-populated server.  At a pre-defined time, registrations will be closed and the migration of all then-registered characters will occur.  You can always cancel emigration during the application process by speaking with the World Shifter again, but once the period is over, you will no longer be able to cancel, and the only way back will be to use the paid character transfer service.

The World Shifter will give you a choice when there is more than one World to pick to migrate to.

*Be sure to remove all items you have listen on the Auction House and in your delivery box, as anything in them will be lost when the transfer takes place.
*Emigration is done one character at a time.  You must request other characters you wish to move separately.
*Any linkshells, linkpearls, and pearl sacks will be destroyed at the time of emigration.  However, linkshell owners will be given a new, unopened linkshell. 
| historicalbackground = 
}}
